key_terms: A deliberately stopped executor process in the owned workshop, which tests task failure without simulating a lost machine or a network partition.
The job and task records the Ballista scheduler keeps. The workshop's default state backend does not promise to retain job history across a scheduler restart.
A query whose completion cannot be established after a failure. The check reports it as unknown instead of silently replaying the job.
A completed query's evidence record, stored with the canonical fixture in an independent owned volume so it survives process restarts.

worked_examples.title: Run the owned failure sequence
worked_examples.code:
cd work/ballista
bash run.sh check
bash run.sh failure-check
bash run.sh evidence
worked_examples.interpretation: The failure check stops the only executor, submits a fresh capacity-failure request that should time out, restarts the scheduler and runs a new check. In the evidence output, the capacity-failure receipt should carry expected_no_capacity_failure as true and a scheduler_outcome saying the result is unknown and nothing was replayed. A passing check after restart is a new request with a new request_id, not the old one resumed.

worked_examples.title: Refuse to replay a pending receipt
worked_examples.code:
folder = ROOT / "receipts"
if list(folder.glob("*.pending")):
    raise ValueError("A pending receipt needs reconciliation; no query was replayed")
paths = sorted(folder.glob("*.json"))
worked_examples.interpretation: This fragment from the project client stops before running anything when a receipt was left pending by an interrupted run. An automatic replay would hide whether the earlier attempt finished. The operator must decide whether the pending request completed, failed or is unknown, and record that decision. The same rule caps stored receipts at 64, so evidence cannot grow without bound across many failure drills.

evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
